hunks.before: fn atom(&mut self, value: Value<'gc>, path: &str, anchors: &Anchors<'gc>, activation: &mut Activation<'_, 'gc>) -> ResultG<Atom> {
if v.len() > MAX_STRING { return Err(format!("oversized string at {path}")); }
hunks.after: if v.len() > MAX_STRING { return Err(format!("oversized string at {}", path())); }

hunks.before: Value::MovieClip(_) => return Err(format!("unbound MovieClip reference at {path}")),
hunks.after: Value::MovieClip(_) => return Err(format!("unbound MovieClip reference at {}", path())),

hunks.before: return Err(format!("unbound function/native object at {path}, kind {}{detail}", anchor_kind(value)?));
hunks.after: return Err(format!("unbound function/native object at {}, kind {}{detail}", path(), anchor_kind(value)?));
